key_insight: A continuous-time policy gradient framework learns from discrete observations, with exponential convergence for an entropy-regularized policy flow.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports control learning under unknown stochastic dynamics while preserving the continuous-time structure of the problem.
method: Derive a performance difference lemma and policy gradients for randomized and parametrized policies.
Analyze policy-flow convergence and separate critic, policy-regression, and step-size contributions to discrete-update error.
Use PhiBE to construct a surrogate generator from discrete transitions for on-policy and off-policy actor-critic learning.
evidence_signal: Experiments evaluate performance and stability on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot, using known and data-driven dynamics.
watch_item: Exponential convergence applies to the analyzed policy flow; practical discrete updates remain sensitive to critic error, policy-regression error, and step size.
paper_title: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
